title: Numeric Tidal ID -> metadata canonical
description: Verifies that raw numeric Tidal track IDs are never erroneously treated as ISRCs and correctly resolve canonical metadata entity.

title: Same ISRC cross-service -> one canonical track, multiple sources
description: Ensures that tracks with identical ISRCs across Qobuz and Tidal resolve to exactly one canonical track record linked to multiple sources.

title: Different masters same title -> distinct tracks
description: Differentiates distinct masters and release editions of the same track name, ensuring separate filesystem paths and track entries.

title: Strict lossless with AAC response -> RejectedQuality
description: Guarantees that requesting lossless audio when only lossy AAC is provided results in strict RejectedQuality failure with no corrupt files saved.

title: Fallback provider exact identity
description: Validates that when the primary provider stream fails, a fallback provider can be resolved while preserving original canonical track identity.

title: No provider -> NoDownloadProvider
description: Ensures proper taxonomic classification as NoDownloadProvider when a track cannot be located on any authenticated streaming provider.

title: Auth invalid vs entitlement vs 404
description: Distinguishes between authentication expiration (RequiresAuth), missing subscription tier (EntitlementMissing), and missing stream (UnavailableFromProvider).

title: Placeholder metadata -> Deferred, no fake canonical entity
description: Rejects synthetic or placeholder values ('Unknown Artist', 'N/A', '???') from becoming permanent canonical database entities.

title: Symbolic title -> tags preserved, safe filename
description: Ensures that titles with illegal filesystem symbols maintain exact tags in FLAC Vorbis comments while producing safe, sanitized filenames on disk.

title: Tagging failure -> rollback
description: Verifies atomic rollback of staging files and database state if metadata tag writing fails midway through download pipeline.

title: Filesystem failure -> rollback
description: Verifies that IO or permission errors during staging-to-library destination movement trigger clean staging deletion and database rollback.

title: Lyrics failure -> best effort success
description: Ensures lyrics fetch failures do not abort the audio download pipeline and result in best-effort download success with diagnostics.

title: Cover failure -> best effort success
description: Ensures cover art fetch or embedding failures degrade gracefully without aborting audio download or leaving corrupt partial audio.

title: Interrupted transfer -> recovery
description: Validates startup crash recovery and operation journal reconciliation for interrupted downloads with partial .part files.

title: Playlist pagination/order
description: Confirms playlist pagination preserves strict sequential track ordering and item counts across API chunks.

title: Fresh import idempotency
description: Re-running import against existing library records performs zero redundant audio downloads and leaves database state invariant.

title: Repair hash mismatch -> abort
description: Aborts metadata re-enrichment / repair if the audio content hash on disk does not match the baseline hash, preventing corrupt retagging.

title: Existing library enrichment precedence
description: Ensures higher-fidelity metadata sources take precedence without overwriting valid user tags or degrading existing artwork.

title: Concurrency settings effective behavior
description: Validates dynamic concurrency enforcement across worker threads without blocking IPC or exceeding configured worker limits.

title: Output path/layout behavior
description: Verifies configurable directory template evaluation ({Artist}/{Album}/{TrackNumber} - {Title}.flac) matching canonical specifications.
